events.config: --[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() rootNote=rootNote or 60 ch=ch or 0 lane_divs={2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32} function cl(v,a,b)return math.max(a,math.min(b,v))end function note_off(e) if e and e.on and e.ln and e.ln>=0 then gms(ch,144,e.ln,0)end if e then e.on=false e.gate=0 end end function refresh_lane(i) local e=ele[i] if not e then return end if (e:bva()or 0)>0 then glc(i,1,0,100,255,0) glp(i,1,cl((e.n or rootNote)*2,80,255)) else glc(i,1,255,0,0,0) glp(i,1,20) end end function init_lane(i) local e=ele[i] local k=cl(e.division_index or 7,1,#lane_divs) e:bmo(1)e:emi(1)e:ema(#lane_divs) e.division_index=k e.divisions=lane_divs[k] e:eva(k)e:bva(0) e.c=-1 e.n=e.n or rootNote glc(i,2,255,255,255,0)glp(i,2,0) e.ln=-1 e.on=false e.gate=0 refresh_lane(i) end init_lane(n)

--[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() init_lane(n) scales={ {0,2,4,5,7,9,11,12},{0,2,3,5,7,9,10,12}, {0,1,3,5,7,8,10,12},{0,2,4,6,7,9,11,12}, {0,2,4,5,7,9,10,12},{0,2,3,5,7,8,10,12}, {0,1,3,5,6,8,10,12} } scale_cols={ {255,0,0},{255,127,0},{255,255,0},{0,255,0}, {0,0,255},{75,0,130},{148,0,211} } function apply_scale() local s=scales[currentScale] for i=0,7 do if currentScale==0 or not s then ele[i].n=rootNote else ele[i].n=cl(rootNote+s[i+1],0,127) end refresh_lane(i) end end function scale_led() local c=scale_cols[currentScale]or{255,255,255} if currentScale==0 then c={0,255,0}end glc(12,1,c[1],c[2],c[3]) glc(12,2,c[1],c[2],c[3]) end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function lane_tick(x) local e=ele[x] if not e then return end e.c=(e.c or -1)+1 if e.c>=(e.divisions or 16)then e.c=0 end if e.c==0 then if (e:bva()or 0)>0 then if e.on then note_off(e)end local n=cl(e.n or rootNote,0,127) e.ln=n gms(ch,144,n,127) e.on=true local g=(e.divisions or 16)*(clock_pulses or 6)*(gate_pct or 50)/100 e.gate=math.max(1,math.floor(g+0.5)) glp(x,2,255) else note_off(e)glp(x,2,0) end else glp(x,2,0) end end

--[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() gate_pct=math.max(10,math.min(80,gate_pct or 50)) gate_cols={{0,255,255},{0,255,0},{255,180,0},{255,0,0}} self:emo(1)self:ev0(50)self:emi(10)self:ema(80) self:eva(gate_pct)self:bmo(0) function gate_led() local p=gate_pct or 50 local k=p<=20 and 1 or p<=40 and 2 or p<=60 and 3 or 4 local c=gate_cols[k] glc(13,1,c[1],c[2],c[3])glp(13,1,math.max(40,p*3))glp(13,2,0) end function gate_tick() for i=0,7 do local e=ele[i] if e.on and(e.gate or 0)>0 then e.gate=e.gate-1 if e.gate==0 then note_off(e)end end end end gate_led()

--[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() clock_divs=clock_divs or{3,6,12,24} clock_labels=clock_labels or{"1/32","1/16","1/8","1/4"} clock_cols=clock_cols or{{0,255,255},{0,120,255},{255,0,255},{255,180,0}} clock_index=math.max(1,math.min(#clock_divs,clock_index or 2)) clock_pulses=clock_divs[clock_index] self:emo(1)self:ev0(50)self:emi(1)self:ema(#clock_divs) self:eva(clock_index)self:bmo(0) if clock_led then clock_led()end glc(n,2,255,255,255)glp(n,2,0) for i=0,7 do if init_lane then init_lane(i)end end if apply_scale then apply_scale()end if scale_led then scale_led()end local z=ele[#ele] z.rtmrx_cb=function(s,h,b)if rt then rt(b)end end z.midirx_cb=function(s,h,e) local a,k,v=e[2],e[3],e[4] if a>=144 and a<=159 and v>0 then rootNote=math.max(0,math.min(127,k)) if apply_scale then apply_scale()end print("rootNote:"..rootNote) end end rx_mode(2,3)
